items.statement: The investigation proposes competing explanations and records candidate generation, deduplication, validation and stopping coverage.

items.statement: Reported CMD stationary points are frequency and connectivity validated per ligand/site object.

items.statement: The independent calculation recovers the source-supported ligand-dependent barrier/ratio interpretation, including the L12 computed ratio.
items.expected: Quantitative results and uncertainty are reported without relying on an author-route hint.
